Idris Pell is weapon-at-the-door host who is slow to anger and hard to fool. The life that shows in public is anchored at Cinder Reach waystation. Idris runs the Cinder Reach waystation and pours tea for anyone who leaves their weapon by the door. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Hospitable, watchful, and slow to anger. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: a story they tell as funny was not funny when it happened and they will deny it until the second conversation. If that truth surfaces at Cinder Reach waystation, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
